meaning.zh:
“除非我死了” 或 “绝不允许”。

这个短语表达了强烈的反对或坚决不允许某事发生的决心。它的字面意思是"除非我死了，不然这件事绝不会发生"。通常用于强调某人对某事的强烈抵制或坚决不认同。
meaning.en: This phrase expresses a strong opposition or determination to prevent something from happening. Its literal meaning is "only over my dead body will this happen". It is often used to highlight someone's strong resistance or firm disapproval of a situation.

lines.en: You want to drop out of school? *Over my dead body*.
She said, "You will marry him *over my dead body*."
lines.zh: 她说: “你想嫁给他，除非我死了。”

lines.en: They want to sell the family house? *Over my dead body*.
lines.zh: 他们想卖掉家里的房子？绝不允许。
